name: Tamar Bridge toll
law: Tamar Bridge and Torpoint Ferry Joint Committee's tolls (Tamar Bridge Acts), payable one way, Saltash (Cornwall) to Plymouth (Devon): vehicles over 3.5 t with 2 axles GBP 7.3, 3 axles 12.0, 4 or more 16.5 (the 'Single' price; towing a trailer costs double, not modelled); with `etc` the TamarTag price. The page gives no date: valid_from is the day it was first read.
